title: chore(engine): pin 0.42.0 differs from latest (0.42.2)
body:
Pinned in `schema/engine-version.txt`: `0.42.0`
Published under `latest`: `0.42.2`

The drift gate stays green throughout: it compares the mirror against
the release this repo pins, so it proves consistency, never currency.

Moving the pin is a deliberate PR:

```
echo "0.42.2" > schema/engine-version.txt
python3 scripts/check_schema_drift.py --update
make lint && make lint-warnings
```

The warning run matters as much as the error run: a new author lint
ships in a release and reaches this content only once the pin moves.
Changelog: https://github.com/astrapi69/learn-content-engine/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

This issue is maintained by `.github/workflows/engine-currency.yml`
and closes itself once the pin catches up.

title: validate_content.py: quality minimums and language rules come from the engine, no copies
body:
## Problem

Since learn-content-engine 0.31 and 0.33 (the fleet pins 0.34.0 since #90) the engine owns:

- the quality minimums: `validateLessonQuality`, with the lesson field `purpose` (`bridge` lifts the exercise and exercise-type minimums, `quiz` the type minimum);
- the language rules: `E-LANG-TAG` (BCP 47), `W-LANG-TAG-CANONICAL`, `W-LANG-PAIR-SAME`, `W-SET-TITLE-NATIVE`, `W-CARD-BACK-SCRIPT`.

`scripts/validate_content.py` still carries Python copies in every repository:

- `MIN_*` from `quality-rules.json`;
- an ISO 639-1 two-letter check that rejects valid tags (`gsw`, `yue`, `fil`);
- `title_native` and a same-language pair as errors.

alc-books additionally recognises bridge lessons by their id (`is_bridge_lesson`).

## Decided

- Engine severity: `W-LANG-PAIR-SAME` and `W-SET-TITLE-NATIVE` stay warnings.
- This ships only with or after #83, the switch that makes selected warning ids blocking. Without it, every repository loses the pressure under which the precision of its copy came about.

## Order

1. #83 (the blocking-warnings switch).
2. alc-books declares `purpose: "bridge"` on its 7 short bridge lessons; alc-traffic-knowledge declares `purpose: "quiz"` on `sets/de/fuehrerschein-uebung/lessons/05-rettungsgasse-einsatzfahrzeuge.json`. The app already reads `purpose`; its share check ignores it until adaptive-learner#3345 is fixed.
3. The template drops the copies; the runner calls `validateLessonQuality`.
4. Propagate per repository (`.github/ownership.json`); alc-books drops `is_bridge_lesson`.

Measure each repository's old gate against the new one over its real content and table the differences in each PR.

Engine 0.34.0 over the 631 fleet lessons (2026-09-30): 8 fall short of the quality minimums, the 8 `purpose` cases above, and none after they declare it.

Blocked by #83. Refs adaptive-learner#3222.

last_comments.body: App-side twin: adaptive-learner#3356. The app's share check keeps the same set-level language copies (two-letter ISO 639-1, same pair and missing `title_native` as errors) and does not call `validateManifestRules`. Same decision, same dependency on #83; both should land in the same round so the app and the repositories block the same things.

**Scope extension from the engine audit of 2026-09-30.** The template carries more copies than listed above:
- `scripts/audit_content.py:39-160` (`make audit`) copies E-CARD/STEP/EXERCISE-ID-DUP (engine rules since 0.32), E-MATCH-DUP-LEFT, E-CLOZE-MS-*, E-TILES-MIN and E-PIC-ONE-CORRECT, with hard-coded quality numbers (matching >= 3 ignoring from_cards). Its cloze check only looks for `___`.
- `validate_content.py` also has a distractor requirement for free_text and picture_choice (no engine counterpart; the app dropped it in adaptive-learner#3348), the card-back script check (6 languages, an error), and the accept_orderings permutation check (the same rule as E-TILES-ORDERING).
- `scripts/validate_with_engine.mjs:265` passes no `sourceLanguage`, so W-CARD-BACK-SCRIPT never fires for set-level source languages.
- `scripts/generate_search_index.py:93-110,266-270` defaults `source_language` to `""` (engine: `"en"`) and has no `language` alias.

title: quality-state: a switch that makes selected warning ids blocking
body:
## The gap

A repository has no way to make an engine **warning** block its own CI without re-implementing the rule as an error.

- The engine runner exits 0 when it only finds warnings (`validate_with_engine.mjs`, "errors-only"); warnings never fail the run by design.
- The warnings step in `.github/workflows/engine-validate.yml` reports them to the job summary and passes the runner's exit code through. Removing its `continue-on-error` surfaces a crash, not a warning.
- The workflow is template-owned and byte-identical in every repository (`.github/ownership.json`), so editing it locally is an ownership finding.
- `.github/quality-state.json` holds each repository's own quality decisions, but today only two: `prose_gate.blocking` and `accepted_warnings`.

So the only way to get "this warning blocks here" today is a second implementation of the rule at error level. The rule-ownership guideline (learn-content-engine `docs/architecture.md`, "Rule ownership") asks repositories not to fork rules; without this switch it asks them to give up a capability with nothing in its place.

## Why this is the missing half of the guideline, not a convenience

(Corrected 2026-09-24: an earlier version of this issue said the template's copy of the hint-length rule "drifted from the engine's warning". The history runs the other way: the template's error-level check came first, from adaptive-learner-content#100/#102 on 2026-07-06; the engine's `W-HINT-LENGTH` followed on 2026-07-10 with its own pattern.)

Severity decides whether a rule is watched. A false hit of a blocking rule stops someone, who has to look at it and clear it; a warning nobody is blocked by is looked at only when someone sets themselves a target, such as zero warnings. Blocking makes a false hit costly and therefore visible. That is a guarantee about what would happen, not a claim about what did: it holds whether a rule was corrected once or was right from its first version. It covers precision, not completeness: a miss stops nobody at any severity.

The hint-length case, measured (learn-content-engine#186 and the follow-up measurement, 2026-09-24):
- Precision: the engine's warning reported 44 hits over the ten repositories, all false, and nothing made them cost anyone anything; they stood as ordinary findings (the hub's 42 in adaptive-learner-content#222). The one false hit anyone examined, under a zero-warnings target in adaptive-learner-content-test#70 (2026-07-14), was diagnosed correctly and then worded around in the content; no engine issue followed, and the rule stayed wrong for 72 more days.
- The template's blocking copy settled all its hits once, at its introduction (adaptive-learner-content#101: 56 real hits rewritten, and its one false hit, a card hint, changed the rule). After that it had no hit at all: about 900 validation runs over about 80 days. Its record is clean because it was empty, not because it was tested. And "blocking" was a convention: no content repository protects its main branch, and red validation runs reached main four times.
- Completeness: pressure found no miss on either side. The template's scaffold carried the narrow first pattern, so nine repositories went without the forms adaptive-learner-content#102 had found in real content, from 2026-07-07 to 2026-09-23; running the hub's tests against the template's code found that (#79).

Since 0.29.0 the merged rule runs in all ten repositories as a warning, and the blocking copy is gone. The content of the rule is better, but it now stands under the same conditions under which the engine's version collected its false hits: the move switched off the cost that would make a false hit visible. A rule move into the engine has to carry the severity along, not only the pattern; when the canonical version only warns there, that cost is lost. The unification is still right, but it is complete only when the severity can be restored at the new place. What this switch gives back is not a correction process but that cost. It does not give back the way back: a false hit that stops a repository has to reach the engine as a report, or it gets worded around in the content, as in adaptive-learner-content-test#70. As long as a rule only warns, a false hit costs nobody anything unless someone sets a target, and it goes unnoticed, which is the state in which the engine's version collected its 44. Without this switch, unifying tells a repository: give up your blocking rule and get a warning back.

## Proposal

A key in `.github/quality-state.json` that lists warning ids this repository treats as blocking, each with the same accountability as the other decisions in the file:

```json
{
  "blocking_warnings": [
    { "rule": "W-HINT-LENGTH", "since": "2026-09-24", "reason": "..." }
  ]
}
```

- `scripts/quality_state.py warnings` gains an exit code: 1 when a warning of a listed rule is present, except for elements recorded under `accepted_warnings` for that rule (compared as `stable_id` sets, as today); 0 otherwise; anything else when the input cannot be read. The step stops passing the runner's 0 through blindly.
- The job summary names the blocking rules and why the step failed.
- `load_state` rejects an entry without `rule`, `since` or `reason`, and a rule id that is not a warning (`W-...`).
- The workflow stays identical everywhere; only the state file differs per repository.

## Tests (TDD)

Reproduction: a listed warning present, the step exits 0 today. Then: listed and present blocks; listed but all elements accepted passes; not listed passes; malformed entry raises; the exit code of a crashed runner still wins.

## Measure before shipping

The switch changes nothing until a repository lists a rule, so shipping it turns nothing red. Before a repository lists a rule, measure what that rule reports there.

title: Die korrigierten Bausteine in die neun Content-Repos spiegeln (Zeilen, nicht Dateien)
body:
PR #63 hat die Em-Dashes hier entfernt und das Prosa-Gate eingebaut. Die
gleichen Bausteine stehen in neun weiteren Repos.

Wichtig fuer die Umsetzung, gemessen am 2026-09-23: die Dateien sind
nah-identisch, aber nicht identisch. `scripts/validate_with_engine.mjs` weicht
in 7 von 9 Repos vom Template ab, `scripts/validate_content.py` in 4. Ueber
alle Repos gibt es 54 verschiedene Em-Dash-Zeilen, davon 33 im Template und 21
nur anderswo.

Also: **Zeilen ersetzen, nicht Dateien kopieren.** Ein Datei-Copy wuerde echte
Repo-Unterschiede ueberschreiben. Die Regel ist mechanisch (mit Leerzeichen
` - `, ohne `-`), der Beweis je Repo ist das Gate selbst: `check_prose.py`
mitliefern, `make prose-check` und den CI-Schritt mitnehmen, danach muss der
Lauf sauber sein.

`schema/` bleibt ueberall ausgenommen, solange die Engine ihre eigenen
Beschreibungen nicht bereinigt hat (learn-content-engine#180).

Reihenfolge: am besten zusammen mit dem jeweiligen Re-Pin, damit ein Repo nicht
zweimal in derselben Woche angefasst wird.

title: Autoren-Lints sichtbar nach Re-Pin auf 0.27.0: Fundliste (398 Warnungen, davon 45 W-PROMPT-DUP)
body:
Nach dem Re-Pin auf `learn-content-engine@0.27.0` laeuft der Warnungs-Lauf
sichtbar in der CI (nicht blockierend). Das ist die erste Fundliste, die dieses
Repo je aus der Warn-Ebene bekommen hat: bis jetzt sah die nur, wer
`make lint-warnings` von Hand startete.

Gemessen am Stand `ddbbe42` mit dem repo-eigenen Runner
(`scripts/validate_with_engine.mjs --warnings`, also mit Extension-Registry,
keine `E-EXT-UNSUPPORTED`-Artefakte): **329 Lektionen + 29 Manifeste, 0 Fehler,
398 Warnungen.**

| Regel | Treffer |
|---|---|
| `W-CARD-UNUSED` | 225 |
| `W-MATCH-AMBIG` | 51 |
| `W-PROMPT-DUP` | 45 |
| `W-HINT-LENGTH` | 42 |
| `W-TILES-DUP` | 29 |
| `W-SET-ORDER-MIXED-PREFIX` | 4 |
| `W-LEVEL-UNKNOWN` | 2 |

## `W-PROMPT-DUP` (der neue Lint aus 0.27.0)

45 Treffer in 13 Lektionen, zwei Sets:

| Set | Treffer | Typ |
|---|---|---|
| `sets/el/fr-a1` | 40 in 8 Lektionen | alle `cloze` |
| `sets/de/ja-a1` | 5 in 5 Lektionen | alle `picture_choice` |

Zwei Beobachtungen, die ueber die Einzeltreffer hinausgehen:

**Alle 45 vergleichen gegen den Schritt-Titel, keiner gegen `sentence`.** Die
Regel prueft beide Felder; in echtem Inhalt schlaegt nur eines an. Das ist kein
Tippfehlerbild, sondern ein Autorenmuster: Titel und Prompt werden aus derselben
Quelle gefuellt.

**Dahinter liegt ein zweites Muster, das der Lint nur teilweise sieht.** Alle 40
`cloze`-Treffer haben eine `sentence`, die ausser Luecken keinen Text enthaelt
(`"___"`). Die Frage steht komplett im Titel und im Prompt, der Traegersatz ist
leer. Repo-weit gilt das fuer **105 von 733 `cloze`-Uebungen** - die uebrigen 65
faellt der Lint nicht auf, weil dort Titel und Prompt unterschiedlich sind,
obwohl die Uebung dieselbe Form hat. Eine `cloze` ohne Traegersatz ist der Sache
nach eine Kurzantwort-Frage mit Antwortfeld, kein Lueckentext.

Beispiele:

- `sets/el/fr-a1/lessons/01-chairetismoi.json`, Schritt 4: Titel = Prompt =
  `Ποιος χαιρετισμός ταιριάζει το βράδυ;`, `sentence` = `___`.
- `sets/de/ja-a1/lessons/01-begruessungen.json`, Schritt 7: Titel = Prompt =
  `Welches Wort bedeutet 'Auf Wiedersehen'?`, kein `sentence` (picture_choice).

Vollstaendige Liste der 13 Lektionen:

```
  4  sets/el/fr-a1/lessons/01-chairetismoi.json
  6  sets/el/fr-a1/lessons/02-arithmoi-ilikia.json
  4  sets/el/fr-a1/lessons/03-arthra-genos.json
  5  sets/el/fr-a1/lessons/04-etre-avoir.json
  5  sets/el/fr-a1/lessons/05-oikogeneia.json
  5  sets/el/fr-a1/lessons/06-fagito-poto.json
  5  sets/el/fr-a1/lessons/07-erotiseis.json
  6  sets/el/fr-a1/lessons/08-chromata-epitheta.json
  1  sets/de/ja-a1/lessons/01-begruessungen.json
  1  sets/de/ja-a1/lessons/02-sich-vorstellen.json
  1  sets/de/ja-a1/lessons/05-einkaufen.json
  1  sets/de/ja-a1/lessons/06-uhrzeit-und-tage.json
  1  sets/de/ja-a1/lessons/08-wegbeschreibung.json
```

## Was hier offen bleibt

Dieses Issue ist die Fundliste, nicht die Entscheidung. Offen ist, ob daraus
eine Regel wird und welche:

1. Die 45 Duplikate abarbeiten (Titel kuerzen oder Prompt als konkrete Aufgabe
   formulieren) - reine Inhaltsarbeit, kein Werkzeug noetig.
2. Die 105 `cloze` ohne Traegersatz: Inhaltsfrage (Satz ergaenzen) oder
   Typfrage (der Uebungstyp passt nicht zur Form). Betrifft mehr als die
   Lint-Treffer.
3. Die restlichen 353 Warnungen (vor allem 225 `W-CARD-UNUSED`) sind
   Altbestand, der jetzt zum ersten Mal sichtbar ist. Sie blockieren nichts.
4. Falls das Muster aus einem Generator stammt, liegt die Ursache dort und
   nicht im Inhalt.

Die CI zeigt die Liste ab jetzt bei jedem PR im Job-Summary, nicht blockierend.

last_comments.body:
Status 2026-10-10, measured on `1a48453` (engine 0.37.0): 329 lessons, 29 manifests, 0 errors, 461 warnings. `W-HINT-LENGTH` 42 -> 0 (the rule still exists); `W-CLOZE-NO-CARRIER` 105 is new, point 2 of this issue became an engine rule. Everything else as listed above.

- **Point 1 (45 `W-PROMPT-DUP`):** #250, titles shortened to headings, ids unchanged, `el/fr-a1` and `de/ja-a1` to 1.0.1. Lint after it: 416 warnings, 0 `W-PROMPT-DUP`; `make stable-ids` green.
- **Point 2 (105 cloze without a carrier):** the owner decided to convert them to their native types (100 `multiple_choice`, 5 `free_text`) on the path that keeps learner progress: learn-content-engine#254 (a declared type migration keeps the `stable_id`). Converting now would mean new ids plus `retired_ids` and archived progress, the option A the 2026-09-23 decision in `.github/quality-state.json` rejected. A conversion built that way exists locally and passes every gate (311 warnings, 105 retired, stability gate green); it is not pushed and will be rebuilt without retirement once #254 ships. The accepted-warnings entry stays until then.
- **Point 3 (225 `W-CARD-UNUSED` and the rest):** unchanged, non-blocking; the engine's `suggest-wiring` can propose card links.
- **Point 4 (generator):** both sets came in as PRs (#84, #89); the history does not say whether a generator was involved.

Side finding: three of the five typed answers in `el/fr-a1` give the answer length away in the hint ("Τρία γράμματα", three letters). `W-HINT-LENGTH` reads German and English number words only, so Greek passes.
